summary: Nucleus sampling cutoff: the model samples only from the smallest set of tokens whose probabilities sum to top_p. Lower values make output more focused, higher values more varied. It is being retired across the Claude line.
combines: Not supported on Claude 4.7 and later, which covers Opus 5, Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 in this group. A value of 0.99 or above is still accepted for backwards compatibility; anything else returns a 400.
Still works on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, the two older models in this group.
Anthropic's guidance is to drop it from request payloads and steer behaviour through prompting and effort instead.
The Python SDK v1.0 removed the parameter from its Messages methods outright.
